name: APK AQUATECH PVT. LTD.
capabilities: Water treatment solutions for semiconductor manufacturing
india_angle: APK Aquatech Pvt. Ltd. is based in India and offers water treatment solutions across various industrial sectors, including semiconductor manufacturing.
summary: APK Aquatech Pvt. Ltd. provides advanced water treatment and wastewater management solutions tailored for semiconductor manufacturing facilities. Their offerings include systems for purified water generation and recycling, crucial for maintaining the high purity water standards required in semiconductor fabs.
